s:
Consider the following statements about Gunaga Vijayaditya III and his commander Pandaranga:
1. Gunaga Vijayaditya III ruled for 43 years.
2. Pandaranga, one of his four Brahmin generals, built Pandurangapuram and a Maheswara temple on Pulicat lake.
3. Pandaranga's Addanki inscription, the first Telugu verse inscription, is in the Champakamala metre.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 2 are correct. 3 is wrong: the Addanki inscription is in the Taruvoja metre; Champakamala is the verse of the Sataluru inscription of Gunaga Vijayaditya.

s:
Match List-I (Inscription) with List-II (Significance):
List-I | List-II
a. Kalamalla | i. First Madhyakkara verse
b. Addanki | ii. First mention of the Kakatiyas
c. Bezawada (Yuddhamalla II) | iii. First Telugu verse, in Taruvoja metre
d. Magallu | iv. Earliest Telugu inscription (pre-Nannaya)
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Kalamalla (c. 575, Renati Choda Dhananjaya) – earliest Telugu inscription; Addanki (Pandaranga) – first Telugu verse in Taruvoja; Bezawada (Yuddhamalla II) – first Madhyakkara verse; Magallu (Danarnava) – first mention of the Kakatiyas (not the Gajapatis).

s:
Consider the following statements about Nannaya:
1. His Andhra Mahabharatamu covers the Adi and Sabha parvas and part of the Aranya parva.
2. The Andhra Mahabharatamu is written in the Dvipada style.
3. He wrote the grammar Andhra Shabda Chintamani and bore the titles Vagadheeshwara and Shabda Shasanudu.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
x: Only two (1 and 3) are correct. 2 is wrong: the Andhra Mahabharatamu, the earliest surviving Telugu literary work, is in the Champu style (verse + prose).

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Narayana Bhattu was sent to Vengi as the representative of the Kalyani Chalukya Someshvara I.
2. The Nandampudi grant was composed by its donee Narayana Bhattu himself.
3. The Korumelli plates of Rajaraja Narendra were written by the same scribe as the Nandampudi grant.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 3 are correct. 2 is wrong: Narayana Bhattu was the donee of Nandampudi village, but Nannaya composed the grant.

s:
Match List-I (Person) with List-II (Work / title):
List-I | List-II
a. Pavuluri Mallana | i. Ashtabhasha Kavisekhara
b. Vemulavada Bhimakavi | ii. Pavuluri Ganitamu
c. Nannaya | iii. Andhra Shabda Chintamani
d. Narayana Bhattu | iv. Kavijanasrayam
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Pavuluri Mallana – Pavuluri Ganitamu (Telugu verse of Mahaviracharya's Ganitasarasangraham, first scientific text in Telugu); Vemulavada Bhimakavi – Kavijanasrayam; Nannaya – the grammar Andhra Shabda Chintamani; Narayana Bhattu – title Ashtabhasha Kavisekhara.

s:
Consider the following statements about the capitals of the Eastern Chalukyas:
1. Pithapuram (Pishtapura) was the first capital, under Kubja Vishnuvardhana.
2. The capital was shifted to Vengi (Pedavegi, near Eluru) by Gunaga Vijayaditya III.
3. Ammaraja I made Rajamahendravaram the capital, and Rajaraja Narendra ruled from it.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 3 are correct. 2 is wrong: Jayasimha Vallabha I shifted the capital to Vengi; the order is Pithapuram – Vengi – Rajamahendravaram.

s:
Match List-I (Old name) with List-II (Place / region):
List-I | List-II
a. Andhra Nagaram | i. Pithapuram
b. Mangalapura | ii. Vengi
c. Venginadu | iii. Mangalagiri
d. Pishtapura | iv. Krishna-Godavari doab
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Andhra Nagaram – Vengi (Dandin's Dashakumaracharita); Mangalapura – Mangalagiri (Kopparam / Marturu records); Venginadu – the Krishna-Godavari doab, the core territory; Pishtapura – Pithapuram, the first capital.

s:
Match List-I (Temple) with List-II (Builder):
List-I | List-II
a. Mukteshwara, Vijayeshwara and Chandrashekhara temples, Bikkavolu | i. Chalukya Bhima I
b. Bhimeswara temples, Draksharama and Samalkot | ii. Rajaraja Narendra
c. Three Shiva temples at Kalidindi for fallen Chola soldiers | iii. Vijayaditya II
d. 108 Shiva temples (Narendreswara) | iv. Gunaga Vijayaditya III
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Bikkavolu group – Gunaga Vijayaditya III; Bhimeswara (Draksharama, Samalkot) – Chalukya Bhima I; Kalidindi temples for Chola soldiers – Rajaraja Narendra; 108 Narendreswara temples – Vijayaditya II.

s:
Consider the following statements about Eastern Chalukya grants to the Jains:
1. The Kaluchumbarru grant for a Jain temple was won by queen Ayyana Mahadevi.
2. Vishnuvardhana III granted Mushikonda to the Jains.
3. Ammaraja II issued the Maliyapundi grant for a Jain temple at Dharmapuri.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 2 and 3 are correct. 1 is wrong: the Kaluchumbarru grant was won by the courtesan Chamekamba; Ayyana Mahadevi built the Nedumba Vasati (Musinikonda grant).

s:
Consider the following statements:
Assertion (A): Temples of the Vengi school were built of local sandstone on a raised jagati.
Reason (R): The Vengi school followed the Vesara (Chalukya) idiom and leads into the Chalukya-Chola style.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Both are true (notes: Vengi school – Vesara/Chalukya idiom, local sandstone not granite, raised jagati, leads into the Chalukya-Chola style), but the stylistic lineage does not explain the choice of building material.

s:
Consider the following statements about the beginnings of the Eastern Chalukyas:
1. Pulakeshin II took Vengi c. 616 after defeating the Vishnukundins.
2. Kubja Vishnuvardhana was made viceroy of Vengi in 617.
3. The Kopparam plates (631) of Pulakeshin II call Kubja Vishnuvardhana 'Maharaja'.
4. The Chipurupalli plates of Kubja Vishnuvardhana, found in Vizianagaram district, are of his 18th regnal year.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
x: Only three (1, 2 and 4) are correct. 3 is wrong: the Kopparam plates of 631 call Kubja Vishnuvardhana 'Yuvaraja'.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi:
1. Their royal emblem was the boar (Varaha).
2. They ruled from 624 to 973 and ended with the rise of the Kalyani Chalukyas.
3. Like the Satavahanas, Ikshvakus and Kadambas, they used the matronymic Hariti-putra.
4. Tribhuvanankusa was the seal sign manual on their copper plates.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1, 3 and 4 are correct. 2 is wrong: they ruled 624–1075 (over four centuries); after 973 the Kalyani Chalukyas were only their main rivals.

s:
Match List-I (Eastern Chalukya ruler) with List-II (Event):
List-I | List-II
a. Vijayaditya I | i. Died at Virajapuri fighting Kalinga
b. Vishnuvardhana IV | ii. Defeated by Dhruva, who married his daughter Sheela Mahadevi
c. Danarnava | iii. Conflict with the Rashtrakuta Dantidurga begins
d. Vijayaditya IV | iv. Killed by Jatachoda Bhima
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Vijayaditya I – conflict with Dantidurga begins; Vishnuvardhana IV – defeated by Dhruva, who married Sheela Mahadevi; Danarnava – killed by Jatachoda Bhima; Vijayaditya IV (Kollabhiganda) – ruled six months and died at Virajapuri.

s:
Consider the following statements about Chalukya Bhima I:
1. The Pithapuram inscription of Mallappadeva credits him with 360 battles.
2. He repelled the Rashtrakuta Krishna II at Koppam and Dharanikota.
3. His court singer and dancer Chellavva bore the title Gandharva-Vidya-Visarada.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 3 are correct. 2 is wrong: Bhima I repelled Krishna II at Niravadyapura and Peruvanguru; Dharanikota and Koppam belong to the 11th-century Chola–Kalyani wars.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. After the battle of Koppam (1053), Rajaraja Narendra had to accept the suzerainty of the Rashtrakutas.
2. Vimaladitya, who married Kundavai, was crowned in 1011.
3. Rajaraja Narendra, crowned in 1022, married Ammanga Devi, daughter of Rajendra Chola.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 2 and 3 are correct. 1 is wrong: after Koppam (1053) Rajaraja Narendra accepted Kalyani Chalukya suzerainty; the Rashtrakutas had fallen by 973.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Vengi succession war of the 11th century:
1. Rajaraja Narendra, son of Kundavai, was backed by Rajendra I.
2. The Chola Rajadhiraja I was killed at Dharanikota by Ahavamalla Someshwara.
3. Vijayaditya VII, son of Melama, was backed by the Kalyani ruler Jayasimha II.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 3 are correct. 2 is wrong: Rajadhiraja I won at Dharanikota and burnt Kollipaka, but was killed at Koppam by Ahavamalla Someshwara.

s:
Consider the following statements:
Assertion (A): Rajendra Chalukya (Kulottunga I) united the Eastern Chalukya and Chola lines.
Reason (R): Kulottunga I married Kundavai, daughter of Rajaraja Chola I.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: A is true: Rajendra Chalukya = Kulottunga I, the first Chalukya-Chola king. R is false: he married Madhurantaki, daughter of Rajendra II; Kundavai married Vimaladitya.

s:
Consider the following statements about Vijayaditya II:
1. His 108 Shiva temples are known as the Narendreswara-alayas.
2. He built them at the sites of his 108 battles in 12 years with the Rashtrakutas, as penance.
3. The temples are recorded in the Addanki inscription.
4. He took the throne by overthrowing his brother Bhima Salki.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
x: Only three (1, 2 and 4) are correct. 3 is wrong: the 108 temples are recorded in the Sataluru inscription; Addanki is Pandaranga's Taruvoja verse record.

s:
Consider the following statements about Chellavva of the Eastern Chalukya court:
1. Chalukya Bhima I gave her the village Attili and two kandikas of land.
2. The Attili inscription compares her father Mallappa to Tumburu.
3. Besides Gandharva-Vidya-Visarada she bore the title Kavigayaka Kalpataru.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
x: Only two (1 and 2) are correct. 3 is wrong: her other title was Samasta Gandharva Vidya Kovida; Kavigayaka Kalpataru was the title of Ammaraja II.

s:
Match List-I (Scholar) with List-II (Work / title):
List-I | List-II
a. Ugradityacharya | i. Kavichakravarti
b. Bhattavamana | ii. Ganitasara Sangraham
c. Bhattudeva | iii. Kavi Vrishabha
d. Pavuluri Mallana | iv. Kalyanakaraka
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Ugradityacharya – Kalyanakaraka (Jain medical treatise); Bhattavamana (Kavyalankara Sutras, court of Chalukya Bhima I) – Kavi Vrishabha; Bhattudeva (Ammaraja II) – Kavichakravarti; Pavuluri Mallana (Rajaraja Narendra) – Ganitasara Sangraham in Telugu.

s:
Match List-I (Eastern Chalukya ruler) with List-II (Literary title / patronage):
List-I | List-II
a. Vishnuvardhana III | i. Kavyageetha Priyudu
b. Ammaraja II | ii. Kavigayaka Kalpataru
c. Rajaraja Narendra | iii. Patron of Bhattavamana, author of the Kavyalankara Sutras
d. Chalukya Bhima I | iv. Kavi Pandita Kamadhenu
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Vishnuvardhana III – Kavi Pandita Kamadhenu; Ammaraja II – Kavigayaka Kalpataru; Rajaraja Narendra – Kavyageetha Priyudu; Chalukya Bhima I – patron of Bhattavamana (and of Chellavva).

s:
Consider the following statements about music, dance and temples of the period:
1. Hallisaka, identified with Kolatam, was the popular dance of the period.
2. Bhairavakona, with eight rock-cut Shiva cave temples, lies in the Nallamala hills of Kurnool district.
3. The Uma Dharmalingeswara temple at Panchadarla (Anakapalli) has Eastern Chalukya and 15th-century inscriptions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 3 are correct. 2 is wrong: Bhairavakona (eight rock-cut Shiva caves, sculptures of musical instruments) is in the Nallamala hills of Prakasam district.

s:
Consider the following statements about Shaivism under the Eastern Chalukyas:
1. The Pasupata sect, founded by Lakulisha, was the oldest.
2. The Kalamukha sect was the peaceful one, while the Pasupatas were extremists.
3. Draksharama, Kaleshwaram and Srisailam formed the Trilinga desa.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
x: Only two (1 and 3) are correct. 2 is wrong: the Pasupatas were the oldest and peaceful sect; the Kalamukhas were the extremists (Kapalikas worshipped Bhairava).

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Danarnava built the Mandavya Narayana temple at Samalkot.
2. Jayasimha I performed the Ashvamedha.
3. Jayasimha II brought the Koya Kottalu (Boya Kottas) into the Brahmanical fold.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: All three are correct (notes: Danarnava – Mandavya Narayana temple, Samalkot; Jayasimha I – Ashvamedha; Jayasimha II – Koya Kottalu).

s:
Consider the following statements:
Assertion (A): The Vaikhanasa Agama is followed for rituals at the Srivari temple, Tirumala.
Reason (R): Pancharatra and Vaikhanasa are Shaiva Agamas.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: A is true (Vaikhanasa, founded by Vikhanasa, is followed at Tirumala). R is false: Pancharatra and Vaikhanasa are Vaishnava traditions, not Shaiva or Shakta.

s:
Consider the following statements about Eastern Chalukya officials:
1. The Samaharta was the chief of the Tirthulu, the council of ministers.
2. The Sthanadhipati managed temples and their endowments.
3. The Pradvivaka was the chief of the council of ministers, whose orders were called jayapatras.
4. The Talari, the village watchman, paid the value of stolen goods if the thief was not caught.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
x: Only three (1, 2 and 4) are correct. 3 is wrong: the Pradvivaka was the king's adviser on judicial matters, and jayapatras were his written verdicts bearing the royal seal.

s:
Match List-I (Nadu) with List-II (Region):
List-I | List-II
a. Pakanadu | i. Bapatla, Ongole, Narasaraopet
b. Palnadu | ii. Nellore
c. Kammanadu | iii. Macharla, Gurajala
d. Venginadu | iv. Krishna and Godavari
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Pakanadu – Nellore; Palnadu – Macharla and Gurajala; Kammanadu – Bapatla, Ongole and Narasaraopet; Venginadu – the Krishna and Godavari region.

s:
Consider the following statements about society under the Eastern Chalukyas:
1. Brahmins were split into Vaidikas and Niyogis, the Niyogis serving in administration and the army.
2. The Vaisyas were called Komatis and their guilds Nakarams.
3. The Panchanamvaru were the five merchant guilds of the ports.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 2 are correct. 3 is wrong: the Panchanamvaru were five artisan groups (blacksmith, goldsmith, brazier, carpenter, sculptor).

s:
Match List-I (Fact) with List-II (Ruler):
List-I | List-II
a. Gold coins found in Arakan (Burma) | i. Kulottunga I
b. Trade with the eastern islands | ii. Chalukya Bhima I
c. 72 merchants sent to China | iii. Saktivarma I
d. Village Attili granted to the court singer Chellavva | iv. Rajaraja Narendra
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Arakan gold coins – Saktivarma I (Chalukya Chandra); trade with the eastern islands – Rajaraja Narendra; 72 merchants to China – Kulottunga I; Attili granted to Chellavva – Chalukya Bhima I.

s:
Consider the following statements about Jain grants of the Eastern Chalukyas:
1. Ammaraja II issued the Kaluchumbarru grant to Arhanandi at the request of Chamekamba.
2. The Maliyapundi grant to the Jinalaya at Dharmavaram was made at the request of the courtesan Chamekamba.
3. Vimaladitya built the Ramakonda cave at Ramatirtham (Vizianagaram) for his guru Trikala Yogi Siddhanta Deva.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 3 are correct. 2 is wrong: Ammaraja II made the Maliyapundi grant at the request of his vassal Durgaraja; Chamekamba was behind the Kaluchumbarru grant.

s:
Consider the following statements:
Assertion (A): The Jains of Potlacheruvu were persecuted by the Kalamukhas and Virashaivas in the Eastern Chalukya period.
Reason (R): Potlacheruvu was the leading Jain centre of the region.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: A is false: the persecution at Potlacheruvu came later, in the Kakatiya age. R is true: Potlacheruvu was the leading Jain centre.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Ghatikas:
1. They were advanced Sanskrit schools attached to agraharas or temples.
2. Mandasharma was the head (Ghatika Samanyulu) of the Kanchi Ghatika.
3. Dhanurveda and Ayurveda were among the subjects taught.
4. Jain pupils began their studies with 'Om Namah Shivaya'.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
x: Only two (1 and 3) are correct. 2 is wrong: Mandasharma headed the Asanapura Ghatika in Kammanadu. 4 is wrong: Jain pupils began with 'Om Namah Siddham'.

s:
Match List-I (Pancharama) with List-II (Place):
List-I | List-II
a. Kumararama | i. Palakollu
b. Somarama | ii. Amaravati
c. Ksheerarama | iii. Samalkot
d. Amararama | iv. Gunupudi, Bhimavaram
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Kumararama – Samalkot (Chalukya Bhimavaram); Somarama – Gunupudi near Bhimavaram; Ksheerarama – Palakollu; Amararama – Amaravati.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Pancharamas:
1. Chalukya Bhima I built the Kumararama temple at Samalkot in memory of his son.
2. The Draksharama temple has a black-granite lingam in its core sanctum.
3. All the Pancharama temples are two-storeyed except Ksheerarama.
4. Somarama is the only Pancharama on the Krishna.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
x: Only two (1 and 3) are correct. 2 is wrong: the black-granite lingam is at Samalkot (Kumararama). 4 is wrong: Amararama (Amaravati) is the one on the Krishna; the other four lie in the Godavari delta.

s:
Consider the following statements about the twin Bhimeswara temples:
1. The Skanda Purana and Srinatha's Bhimeswara Puranam are literary sources on the Draksharama temple.
2. The Samalkot temple, with its huge Nandi mandapa, is one of the Trilinga kshetras.
3. As Jananathapura, Draksharama was the coronation seat of the Chalukya-Chola viceroys of Vengi.
4. Sapta Godavari is the sacred tank (pushkarini) of the Draksharama temple.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1, 3 and 4 are correct. 2 is wrong: it is Draksharama that has the huge Nandi mandapa and is one of the Trilinga kshetras; Samalkot has a towering gopuram added later.

s:
Consider the following statements:
Assertion (A): Vijayaditya II built 108 Shiva temples known as the Narendreswara (Narendra Mrigeswara) temples.
Reason (R): He fought 108 battles in 12 years against the Rashtrakutas and their Gangavadi allies and built a temple at each battle site.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Both are true and R explains A: the 108 temples stand at the sites of his 108 battles, as recorded in the Sataluru inscription (not Kopparam).

s:
Consider the following statements about the Bikkavolu (Biccavolu) temples:
1. Mukteswara is the only temple of the group still standing.
2. The ASI attributes the whole group to Gunaga Vijayaditya III.
3. The Vijayeswara temple has carved Ganga and Yamuna figures.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 2 and 3 are correct. 1 is wrong: Golingeswara is the only temple of the Bikkavolu group still standing.

s:
Match List-I (Temple) with List-II (Builder):
List-I | List-II
a. Kumaraswamy temple, Chebrolu | i. Bhattupu, commander of Bhima I
b. Parvateswara temple, Indrakeeladri (Bezawada) | ii. Chalukya Bhima I
c. Mandavya Narayana temple, Samalkot | iii. Kubja Vishnuvardhana
d. Kunti Madhava temple, Pithapuram | iv. Danarnava
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Kumaraswamy, Chebrolu – Chalukya Bhima I; Parvateswara, Indrakeeladri – Bhattupu, his commander; Mandavya Narayana (Raja Narayana), Samalkot – Danarnava; Kunti Madhava, Pithapuram – Kubja Vishnuvardhana.

s:
Consider the following statements about Eastern Chalukya architecture:
1. The Vengi School built mainly Dravida temples combining Pallava and Badami Chalukya influences with local features.
2. Its temple building was concentrated in the Krishna-Godavari delta.
3. The nine Navabrahma temples at Alampur were built by the Eastern Chalukyas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 1 and 2 are correct. 3 is wrong: the Navabrahma temples at Alampur (7th–8th c.) belong to the Badami Chalukyas.
